courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 黑部水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「本地入流與越域供水」與「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黑部水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Local inflow and imported supply" and "Catchment storm runoff volume" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Kurobe Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦越域引水與公共原水供應韌性；黑部水壩則以高山拱壩承載與高水頭水能系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on interbasin diversion and resilient raw water supply; Kurobe Dam centres on mountain arch action and high head energy systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「本地入流與越域供水」與「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黑部水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「快速流速變化與水錘」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Local inflow and imported supply” and “Snowmelt pulses and storage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Kurobe Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rapid velocity change and water hammer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 南化水庫大壩
history.text: 水利署歷史文章區分一九九三年七月開始蓄水、一九九四年三月主要工程完成與同年七月正式供水，並列出壩高八十七點五公尺的分區土石壩。甲仙越域引水是供水背景，不表示本課使用現行取水權限或時刻表。文章內當時預測的後續工程日期沒有當成已實現事件引用。課程使用墾務局公開索引作容量計算、滲流及量測研究入口；與黑部的比較只針對水量與能量的不同用途。
history.textEn: The WRA history separates initial impoundment in July 1993, completion of main works in March 1994 and formal supply in July 1994, and lists an 87.5 m zoned embankment. Jiaxian diversion establishes supply context without providing current abstraction permissions or schedules. Later predicted dates in that historical article are not represented as completed events. Public Reclamation indexes offer entry points for capacity, seepage and measurement study. Comparison with Kurobe concerns different uses of water and energy rather than equivalent operating conditions.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「本地入流與越域供水」到「管網水量差與誤差範圍」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Local inflow and imported supply" through "Network imbalance and uncertainty" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
